title: Conquista y resistencia
goal: Read about two Caribbean resistance leaders a generation apart, one executed for refusing baptism and one whose revolt forced the Spanish crown to the negotiating table.

items: Explain why Hatuey fled from La Española to Cuba.
Explain why Hatuey reportedly refused baptism before his execution.
Describe what made Enriquillo's rebellion exceptional.
Explain what the 1533 peace agreement actually recognized.
Use se-constructions (passive, impersonal, reporting) in historical narration.
